provenance: Original Blender sources contain no visibility curves or values. These are explicit reviewed selections for the current base identities, not recovered native visibility keyframes.

cramorant.decision: Base Cramorant excludes both fish meshes and both swallowed Pikachu meshes. All seven native clips inspected.

deoxys.decision: Normal Deoxys uses animated paired tentacles (arm2); alternate humanoid hands and transient sphere are excluded. All seven native clips inspected.

minior.decision: Base identity is the meteor shell. Keep shell and its inner spike geometry; exclude exposed-core eye/mouth overlays and detached shell fragments. Combined normal/shiny meteor geometry reviewed in all seven native clips.

togedemaru.decision: Exact admitted scene names are misleading: EffGcloud01 contains the complete normal body, face, limbs and tail. Exclude the tucked duplicate body and two alternate needle sets. All seven native clips inspected.
